changeSet.author: hem
changeSet.sql:
ALTER TABLE aid_requests ADD CONSTRAINT ck_aid_requests_request_id_not_blank CHECK (btrim(request_id) <> ''),
ADD CONSTRAINT ck_aid_requests_latitude CHECK (latitude BETWEEN -90.0 AND 90.0),
ADD CONSTRAINT ck_aid_requests_longitude CHECK (longitude BETWEEN -180.0 AND 180.0),
ADD CONSTRAINT ck_aid_requests_need_category CHECK (need_category IN ( 'MEDICAL', 'FOOD', 'SHELTER', 'WATER' )),
ADD CONSTRAINT ck_aid_requests_priority CHECK (priority IN ( 'STANDARD', 'URGENT' )),
ADD CONSTRAINT ck_aid_requests_status CHECK (status IN ( 'RECEIVED', 'REQUIRES_REVIEW', 'VALIDATED', 'MATCH_PENDING', 'RESERVATION_FAILED', 'RESERVED', 'DISPATCHED', 'DELIVERED', 'COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED' )),
ADD CONSTRAINT ck_aid_requests_version CHECK (version >= 0),
ADD CONSTRAINT ck_aid_requests_reservation_id_not_blank CHECK ( reservation_id IS NULL OR btrim(reservation_id) <> '' ),
ADD CONSTRAINT ck_aid_requests_failure_reason_not_blank CHECK ( reservation_failure_reason IS NULL OR btrim(reservation_failure_reason) <> '' ),
ADD CONSTRAINT ck_aid_requests_dispatch_reference_not_blank CHECK ( dispatch_responder_reference IS NULL OR btrim(dispatch_responder_reference) <> '' ),
ADD CONSTRAINT ck_aid_requests_delivery_reference_not_blank CHECK ( delivery_confirmation_reference IS NULL OR btrim(delivery_confirmation_reference) <> '' ),
ADD CONSTRAINT ck_aid_requests_cancellation_reason_not_blank CHECK ( cancellation_reason IS NULL OR btrim(cancellation_reason) <> '' );

ALTER TABLE aid_requests ADD CONSTRAINT ck_aid_requests_dispatch_details_complete CHECK ( (dispatch_responder_reference IS NULL) = (dispatched_at IS NULL) ),
ADD CONSTRAINT ck_aid_requests_delivery_details_complete CHECK ( (delivery_confirmation_reference IS NULL) = (delivered_at IS NULL) ),
ADD CONSTRAINT ck_aid_requests_delivery_time CHECK ( delivered_at IS NULL OR dispatched_at IS NULL OR delivered_at >= dispatched_at ),
ADD CONSTRAINT ck_aid_requests_reservation_allowed_state CHECK ( reservation_id IS NULL OR status IN ( 'RESERVED', 'DISPATCHED', 'DELIVERED', 'COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED' ) ),
ADD CONSTRAINT ck_aid_requests_reservation_required_state CHECK ( status NOT IN ( 'RESERVED', 'DISPATCHED', 'DELIVERED', 'COMPLETED' ) OR reservation_id IS NOT NULL ),
ADD CONSTRAINT ck_aid_requests_failure_allowed_state CHECK ( reservation_failure_reason IS NULL OR status IN ( 'RESERVATION_FAILED', 'CANCELLED' ) ),
ADD CONSTRAINT ck_aid_requests_failure_required_state CHECK ( status <> 'RESERVATION_FAILED' OR reservation_failure_reason IS NOT NULL ),
ADD CONSTRAINT ck_aid_requests_reservation_outcome_exclusive CHECK ( reservation_id IS NULL OR reservation_failure_reason IS NULL ),
ADD CONSTRAINT ck_aid_requests_dispatch_state CHECK ( (status IN ( 'DISPATCHED', 'DELIVERED', 'COMPLETED' )) = (dispatch_responder_reference IS NOT NULL) ),
ADD CONSTRAINT ck_aid_requests_delivery_state CHECK ( (status IN ( 'DELIVERED', 'COMPLETED' )) = (delivery_confirmation_reference IS NOT NULL) ),
ADD CONSTRAINT ck_aid_requests_cancellation_state CHECK ( (status = 'CANCELLED') = (cancellation_reason IS NOT NULL) );
